beats.caption: One prompt. 2.1 million views. No video model.
beats.narration: A music video made from one prompt reached 2.1 million views, the post says. The model that made it cannot output video at all.

beats.caption: Do not ask for a video. Ask for time t.
beats.narration: Here is the trick. Do not ask for a video. Ask for the picture at time t. Then ask nine hundred times.

beats.caption: seek(t): set the scene for one instant
beats.narration: The model writes a program with one special function, seek. Give it a time and it arranges everything exactly as that instant should look.

beats.caption: A browser with no window takes the photo
beats.narration: A headless browser, a browser with no window, loads the program, calls seek, and takes a screenshot. One photo per frame.

beats.caption: 15 seconds × 60 frames = 900 photos
beats.narration: Fifteen seconds at sixty frames per second is nine hundred photos. Same time, same picture, every run.

beats.caption: ffmpeg glues the photos and lays the sound
beats.narration: ffmpeg glues the photos into a film and lays the audio underneath. That is the whole machine.

beats.caption: The kit: eight pieces, not one prompt
beats.narration: The strongest videos were not one clever prompt. They came from a kit of eight pieces.

beats.caption: Brief, references, storyboards, spring motion
beats.narration: A production brief. Visual references. Storyboards written as states. Spring-based motion with synthesized audio.

beats.caption: Render, look, fix the worst three
beats.narration: The model cannot watch its film, so it reads a contact sheet, a grid of frames, scores it, and fixes the worst three issues. Then renders again.

beats.caption: Long briefs, high effort, overnight runs
beats.narration: What the viral runs shared, the post says: long briefs, high effort settings instead of the default, and overnight runs.

beats.caption: This video was made this way
beats.narration: This video was rendered exactly this way: a seek function, a headless browser, thirty frames per second, ffmpeg. The program is in the repo.

beats.narration: The video is a program. Read the article to see every piece.
